drafts.subject: Your navy hoodie order
drafts.body:
Hi Yale AI Club! We have 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in M available now. If you’d like to fill the 20-piece order from shelf stock, we also have S (4), L (14), and XL (6), so there are enough across sizes—just let us know the mix you’d like.

Your student-group discount is 10% ($5.80 off each hoodie), bringing each hoodie to $52.20; student ID will be checked at pickup. We can also add a Yale Cap for each member at the same discount. Custom club designs are something you can discuss with our staff.

If you prefer all 20 in M, we can put you on a waitlist, but no restock has been approved or promised. The vendor is currently blocked by an unpaid invoice, and its 5-day lead time would begin only after that invoice is paid. Which sizes would you prefer, or would you like the M waitlist?

Campus Customs

next_steps: Await the club’s requested size mix; do not promise the M restock. A restock would require the vendor block to be cleared and funding consistent with the $500 cushion and required deposit.
